$comment: The first node of the quest The abbot of the isle, quests/abbot.json: an abbot asks what the house holds dearest, and how it is answered decides the quest's road - pleased leads to a pledge, doubts to a castle on an island. Spoken by people of its own, as a quest's dialogues are. Every word a placeholder; taken over on 2026-10-16 from the sample written in the code. See decision record 0097.
title: The abbot at the gate

arrives.says: An abbot waits at the gate, salt on his habit. On his island the light has gone out, he says.

asks.says: He would raise a mission there, and asks first what your house holds dearest.

pleased.says: Then a gift of faith will do. Pledge what piety the house can spare to the mission.

doubts.says: Then coin alone will not light it. Hold a castle on the island, and send wealth to keep the fire.
